hook: Overnight downpour: Kukatpally gets *79.3 mm*, dry spell over
hook_b: Overnight downpour: Kukatpally gets *79.3 mm*, dry spell over
tldr: A sharp spell of rain after 1 a.m. on Friday flooded parts of west Hyderabad and disrupted power in places; the IMD expects minimum temperatures to fall 2-4 degrees over five days.

beats.what: Almost all of Hyderabad got rain between 8.30 am Thursday and 8.30 am Friday, heaviest in Kukatpally, Safilguda and Shaikpet.
beats.why: It ended a nearly month-long dry spell; the spread was uneven, with some areas getting only a brief spell.
beats.care: Areas around Hafeezpet station flooded and power supply was disrupted in parts of the city.

cards.title: 🆕 What's new
cards.body: Midday update: Siasat calls it Hyderabad's heaviest November rain in 10 years, with 60-80 mm in some areas in just three hours (midnight to 3 am). Outside the city, Bhongir received 12 cm by 6 a.m. and Alair 10 cm.

cards.q: How much rain did your area get last night?

qs: Which drains overflowed, and how quickly was water cleared?
Will this rain help groundwater after the dry spell?

facts.t: Bhongir got *12 cm* of rain by 6 a.m., Alair 10 cm.
Shamshabad, Nadargul, Kanchanbagh and Bachupally got *1 mm or less*.
Heaviest *November* rain in Hyderabad in *10 years*, after 28 dry days.

card.title: Rain in 24 hrs to 8.30 am Friday (mm)

viz.verdict: Heavy in the west and north-east; south and east got little or none.

watch: Rain eases across Telangana from Nov 28; a strong chill is likely in Hyderabad on Nov 29, 30 and Dec 1.
